practiceParts.label: Speaking Part 1
practiceParts.format: Examiner asks 4-5 questions on 2-3 familiar topics

questions: Do you work or are you a student?
What do you like most about your job or course?
Is there anything you find difficult about it?
Why did you choose this kind of work or subject?
What would you like to do in the future?
What do you like most about your hometown?
Has your hometown changed much since you were a child?
Would you like to live there in the future?
Is your hometown a good place for young people?
